# ANCFBeamGeometricallyExactComparisonTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [ANCFBeamGeometricallyExactComparisonTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/ANCFBeamGeometricallyExactComparisonTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  ObjectANCFBeam against ObjectBeamGeometricallyExact (#2228): the same cantilever, the same section data,
#           8 elements each. (1) static general bending by a tip torque [Mx, My] on the tip node (the case of Nachbagauer,
#           Gruber, Gerstmayr 2013 in ANCFBeamTest.py): tip position and tip rotation matrix - for the ANCF beam the
#           symmetric basis of the slopes of NodePointSlope23 - agree; (2) a tip torque through MarkerBodyRigid on the end
#           of the last element, static: the rotation Jacobian of the element and its derivative; (3) the same torque,
#           dynamic: the frame and the angular velocity of the end of the element are those of its end node. The cross
#           section penalty factor is 100: the slopes of the ANCF beam then stay orthogonal to 0.005 degrees, so that its
#           frame describes a rigid cross section, as the geometrically exact beam has.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-13
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
import numpy as np
from exudyn import cMath #the norm of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform

SC = exu.SystemContainer()

#the cantilever of ANCFBeamTest.py, case 2 (general bending)
L = 2
h = 0.2         #height, y
w = 0.4         #width, z
Em = 2.07e11
nu = 0.3
rho = 1e2
ks1, ks2, ks3 = 0.5768, 0.8331, 0.7961
A = h*w
Gm = Em/(2*(1 + nu))
Iyy = h*w**3/12
Izz = w*h**3/12
J = Iyy + Izz
nElements = 8
lElem = L/nElements

sectionData = exu.BeamSection()
sectionData.stiffnessMatrix = np.diag([Em*A, Gm*A*ks2, Gm*A*ks3, Gm*J*ks1, Em*Iyy, Em*Izz])
sectionData.inertia = rho*J*np.eye(3)
sectionData.massPerLength = rho*A

def Cantilever(useANCF, torque, torqueOnElement):
    """the cantilever and its tip node and last element; the torque on the tip node or on the end of the last element"""
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    nGround = mbs.AddNode(NodePointGround())
    if useANCF:
        nodes = [mbs.AddNode(NodePointSlope23(referenceCoordinates=[lElem*k, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1])) for k in range(nElements + 1)]
        elements = [mbs.AddObject(ObjectANCFBeam(nodeNumbers=nodes[k:k+2], length=lElem, sectionData=sectionData,
                                                 crossSectionPenaltyFactor=[100, 100, 100])) for k in range(nElements)]
        mGround = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeCoordinate(nodeNumber=nGround, coordinate=0))
        for i in range(9):
            mbs.AddObject(CoordinateConstraint(markerNumbers=[mGround, mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeCoordinate(nodeNumber=nodes[0], coordinate=i))]))
    else:
        nodes = [mbs.AddNode(NodeRigidBodyEP(referenceCoordinates=[lElem*k, 0, 0] + eulerParameters0)) for k in range(nElements + 1)]
        elements = [mbs.AddObject(ObjectBeamGeometricallyExact(nodeNumbers=nodes[k:k+2], length=lElem,
                                                               sectionData=sectionData)) for k in range(nElements)]
        oGround = mbs.AddObject(ObjectGround())
        mbs.AddObject(GenericJoint(markerNumbers=[mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=oGround)),
                                                  mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeRigid(nodeNumber=nodes[0]))]))
    if torqueOnElement:
        mTip = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=elements[-1], localPosition=[lElem if useANCF else 0.5*lElem, 0, 0]))
    else:
        mTip = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeRigid(nodeNumber=nodes[-1]))
    mbs.AddLoad(Torque(markerNumber=mTip, loadVector=torque))
    mbs.Assemble()
    return (mbs, nodes[-1], elements[-1])

def Settings():
    simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
    simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False
    simulationSettings.staticSolver.verboseMode = 0
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    simulationSettings.linearSolver.solverType = exu.LinearSolverType.EigenSparse
    simulationSettings.staticSolver.numberOfLoadSteps = 5
    simulationSettings.staticSolver.newton.relativeTolerance = 1e-10
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.relativeTolerance = 1e-10
    return simulationSettings

OVT = exu.OutputVariableType
results = {}

#(1) static general bending
for useANCF in [True, False]:
    (mbs, tipNode, lastElement) = Cantilever(useANCF, [0.5e6, 2e6, 0], False)
    mbs.SolveStatic(Settings())
    results[('static', useANCF)] = (mbs.GetNodeOutput(tipNode, OVT.Position),
                                    mbs.GetNodeOutput(tipNode, OVT.RotationMatrix).reshape(3, 3))

#(2) static, a large twist and a bending torque on the end of the last element, through MarkerBodyRigid: the rotation
#Jacobian of the element and its derivative
for useANCF in [True, False]:
    (mbs, tipNode, lastElement) = Cantilever(useANCF, [4e6, 0, 2e6], True)
    mbs.SolveStatic(Settings())
    results[('element', useANCF)] = (mbs.GetNodeOutput(tipNode, OVT.Position),
                                     mbs.GetNodeOutput(tipNode, OVT.RotationMatrix).reshape(3, 3))

#(3) dynamic, the ANCF beam with the torque on the element: the frame and the angular velocity of the element end are
#those of its end node
(mbs, tipNode, lastElement) = Cantilever(True, [2e5, 0, 5e5], True)
simulationSettings = Settings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 100
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.005
mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
end = [0.5*lElem, 0, 0] #the end of the element, which ranges from -L/2 to L/2
dynamicDifferences = (np.abs(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(lastElement, OVT.RotationMatrix, localPosition=end).reshape(3, 3)
                             - mbs.GetNodeOutput(tipNode, OVT.RotationMatrix).reshape(3, 3)).max(),
                      np.abs(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(lastElement, OVT.AngularVelocity, localPosition=end)
                             - mbs.GetNodeOutput(tipNode, OVT.AngularVelocity)).max())
tipDynamic = mbs.GetNodeOutput(tipNode, OVT.Position)

checks = []
#the tolerances: the differences of the two elements with 8 elements; they fall as the elements are refined - the
#displacements with the square of the element length, the rotation of the element case linearly
for (case, tolerance) in [('static', 1e-3), ('element', 2e-2)]:
    (pA, RA) = results[(case, True)]
    (pG, RG) = results[(case, False)]
    dp = cMath.norm(pA - pG)/cMath.norm(pG - [L, 0, 0])
    dR = np.abs(RA - RG).max()
    exu.Print(case + ': tip position ANCF', pA, ', geometrically exact', pG)
    exu.Print(case + ': relative difference of the tip displacement', dp, ', largest difference of the rotation matrices', dR)
    checks += [dp < tolerance, dR < tolerance]
exu.Print('dynamic: element end - end node, rotation matrix', dynamicDifferences[0], ', angular velocity', dynamicDifferences[1])
checks += [dynamicDifferences[0] < 1e-14, dynamicDifferences[1] < 1e-12]

exu.Print('checks:', checks)
u = sum(checks) - len(checks) + cMath.norm(results[('static', True)][0]) + cMath.norm(results[('element', True)][0]) + cMath.norm(tipDynamic)
exu.Print('solution of ANCFBeamGeometricallyExactComparisonTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
